# Grant Radar

> Open U.S. federal grants, sorted by deadline, amount and who can apply — with plain-English guides to applying.

Guides are researched from official sources, cite them, and are reviewed regularly.

## Guides
- [How to Check SAM.gov Registration Status (Step by Step)](https://aobaworks.com/grant-radar/how-to-check-sam-gov-registration-status-step-by-step/): Learn how to check SAM.gov registration status in Workspace or the public entity search, what Active, Inactive and Submitted mean, and what to do next.
